subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice selector work be scoped to Android first, or should it wait for a shared companion-app UX decision across Android, iOS, and macOS?
rationale: Current source proves the Android Talk path still lacks target selection, but the issue wording spans multiple companion apps and a selector can affect session-state semantics, so automation should not pick the platform scope or UX without maintainer intent.

options.title: Android Talk first
options.body: Implement Android Talk/Voice target selection using existing gateway agent/session state, then track macOS/iOS parity separately if needed.

options.title: Shared companion design first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define one cross-platform Talk/Voice target model for Android, iOS, and macOS.

options.title: Defer voice routing
options.body: Keep per-agent TTS as the only completed part for now and leave Talk/Voice agent switching out of the near-term roadmap.

recommendation.title: Android Talk first
recommendation.body: Implement Android Talk/Voice target selection using existing gateway agent/session state, then track macOS/iOS parity separately if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already scoped the partial TTS implementation versus remaining Talk/Voice selector work in the issue discussion and has related TTS/Talk config history.
